mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400 units, sustained for 2 months, indicates strengthening demand, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or HOUST's lead over consumer spending growth weakens (Rank IC < 0.02).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields in equities.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeds 2% YoY and coincides with a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.5%), it signals a supply chain bottleneck, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to impending inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the predicted inflationary pressures do not materialize (CPIAUCSL growth < 2% YoY).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 jobs in a single month indicates a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market impact on consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the labor market's lead over consumer confidence growth weakens (Rank IC < 0.02).

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth slowing down to less than 1.5% YoY, coupled with a decrease in retail sales (RSAFS), signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth < 1.5% and RSAFS decrease
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the predicted demand weakness does not materialize (continued GDPC1 growth > 2% YoY).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points within a quarter signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as borrowing costs rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the tightening cycle's impact on borrowing costs is muted (less than 20% increase in 10-year Treasury yields).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeding 3% YoY without a corresponding increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals supply chain efficiency gains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to improved productivity.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY growth > 3% and PAYEMS growth < 1.5%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the predicted productivity gains do not materialize (productivity growth < 1% YoY).

mechanism_narrative: A low and stable unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4%) coupled with moderate payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth between 100,000 to 200,000 jobs per month signals a balanced labor market, leading to stable S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX exhibits high volatility (> 20% annualized) in > 50% of triggered instances despite stable signal, or the labor market's balance is disrupted (UNRATE spikes above 5% or PAYEMS growth falls below 50,000).
